name: Ferdinand Marienfeld
original_name: フェルディナント・マリエンフェルト
source:
Louise's target.

An eccentric upper-class young man. He likes to play the piano and drink tea, and many other elegant things. His overactive imagination and his narcissistic personality are his weak points.

[From in-game profile]
